title: Where is the ring?
lines: Last episode: one frame passed J1, then J2, 310 ns apart.
上一集：同一帧先经过 J1，再经过 J2，相差 310 纳秒。
People say EtherCAT is a ring: the frame goes round and comes back.
大家都说 EtherCAT 是一个环：帧绕一圈再回来。
But look at our line. One cable from the master, slave to slave, and the last one goes nowhere.
可看看我们的总线：一根网线从主站出发，一个接一个，最后一个从站后面什么也没接。
That is a line, not a ring. So where is the ring?
这是一条线，不是环。那环在哪里？

title: Inside the cable
lines: Open an Ethernet cable: eight wires, twisted into four pairs.
剥开一根网线：8 根线，两两绞成 4 对。
EtherCAT runs at 100 Mbit/s, and that speed uses only two of the pairs.
EtherCAT 跑 100 Mbit/s，这个速率只用其中 2 对。
Pins 1 and 2: one pair that sends. Pins 3 and 6: one pair that receives.
1、2 脚是一对，负责发；3、6 脚是一对，负责收。
Both pairs work at the same time. This is called full duplex.
两对同时工作，这叫全双工。
Like a road with two lanes: traffic goes both ways at once, and never meets.
就像一条双车道的路：两个方向同时通车，互不相撞。

title: Every link is two lanes
lines: Now draw our line that way: every cable becomes two lanes.
按这个样子重画我们的总线：每根网线都变成两条车道。
The lane away from the master we call outgoing. The lane back we call return.
离开主站的那条叫去程，回主站的那条叫回程。
Three cables, so three outgoing lanes and three return lanes.
三根网线，就有三条去程、三条回程。
The question is now: what happens inside each slave, where the lanes meet?
问题变成了：车道在每个从站里汇合，那里发生了什么？

title: Inside a slave
lines: Every slave has a chip for EtherCAT, the ESC: EtherCAT Slave Controller.
每个从站里有一颗专管 EtherCAT 的芯片，叫 ESC（EtherCAT 从站控制器）。
Our ESCs have two ports. Port 0 faces the master: IN. Port 1 faces away: OUT.
我们的 ESC 有两个口。口 0 朝着主站，标 IN；口 1 背着主站，标 OUT。
A frame arriving at port 0 goes through the processing unit, then out of port 1.
从口 0 进来的帧，先经过处理单元，再从口 1 出去。
The processing unit reads and writes this slave's data in the frame, as it passes.
处理单元就在帧经过时，读写帧里属于这个从站的数据。
A frame arriving at port 1 skips it, and goes straight out of port 0.
从口 1 进来的帧不经过它，直接从口 0 出去。
So each slave works on the frame once, on the way out. The return trip is just forwarding.
所以每个从站只在去程上处理一次这一帧，回程只是转发。

title: Turning around at a closed port
lines: Now the last slave, J2. Nothing is plugged into its port 1.
再看最后一个从站 J2：它的口 1 上什么也没插。
No cable means no link. The ESC sees that and closes the port.
没插线就没有链路。ESC 发现了，就把这个口关掉。
A closed port does not send. The frame is passed inside the chip to the next port instead.
关闭的口不往外发，帧在芯片内部直接交给下一个口。
For two ports, the next port after 1 is port 0. So the frame turns around and heads home.
两个口的芯片，口 1 的下一个就是口 0。于是帧掉头，往回走。
Like a dead-end street with a turning circle at the end.
就像一条死胡同，尽头有个掉头的圆环。
Nobody configured this. It happens because the cable is missing.
这不需要谁去配置：没插线，它就自动发生。

title: One frame's trip
lines: Now follow one frame from the master, with a stopwatch.
现在拿着秒表，跟着一帧从主站出发。
Guess first: how long until its first bit is back at the master?
先猜：它的第一个比特要多久才回到主站？
pause
10 ns: it reaches slave 1. 2 m of cable at a simulated 5 ns per metre.
10 纳秒：到达从站 1。2 米网线，模拟的每米 5 纳秒。
320 ns: it reaches J1. 630 ns: it reaches J2.
320 纳秒到 J1，630 纳秒到 J2。
Each slave on the way out adds 305 ns, the ET1100 datasheet's average through the processing unit.
去程上每个从站添 305 纳秒：ET1100 数据手册里经过处理单元的平均值。
935 ns: it leaves J2 again, turned around.
935 纳秒：掉过头，又从 J2 出来。
On the way back each slave adds 265 ns: forwarding alongside the unit is a little quicker.
回程每个从站添 265 纳秒：从旁边转发，稍快一点。
1205 ns: it leaves J1. 1475 ns: it leaves slave 1.
1205 纳秒离开 J1，1475 纳秒离开从站 1。
1485 ns: back at the master. About 1.5 µs for the whole trip.
1485 纳秒：回到主站。整趟约 1.5 微秒。
The cable and chip delays are simulated. The path the frame takes is what the chip's rules say.
网线和芯片延迟是模拟的；帧走哪条路，是芯片规则决定的。

title: So it is a ring
lines: Now look at the path: out on every outgoing lane, back on every return lane.
现在看这条路径：去程走遍每一条去程车道，回程走遍每一条回程车道。
It never doubles back halfway, and no lane is used twice.
中途不折返，也没有哪条车道走两次。
That is a ring. It is just folded inside the cables.
这就是一个环，只不过折叠在网线里面。
The master needs one Ethernet port: it sends on one pair and receives on the other.
主站只需要一个网口：一对线发，另一对线收。
And every frame visits every slave, in the same order, every time.
而且每一帧都按同样的顺序经过每一个从站，每一次都一样。

title: Cut the cable
lines: Now cut the cable between J1 and J2.
现在把 J1 和 J2 之间的网线剪断。
Guess: how many slaves will the master find? And where does the frame turn around?
猜一猜：主站会找到几个从站？帧在哪里掉头？
pause
J1's port 1 loses its link, so it closes. The frame now turns at J1.
J1 的口 1 失去链路，于是关闭。帧现在在 J1 掉头。
The master finds 2 slaves. J2 may still be powered, but no frame reaches it.
主站找到 2 个从站。J2 也许还通着电，但没有帧能到它那里。
The trip is shorter: 905 ns instead of 1485 ns.
行程变短：905 纳秒，而不是 1485 纳秒。
Nothing crashed, and nothing needed reconfiguring. The ring just got shorter.
没有崩溃，也不用重新配置：环只是变短了。

title: How SOEM sees it
lines: How does the master know? Two small pieces of SOEM.
主站怎么知道的？SOEM 里有两小段代码。
First it counts: one broadcast read, and every slave it passes adds 1 to a counter in the frame.
先数人数：发一个广播读，每经过一个从站，帧里的计数器就加 1。
The counter comes back as 3, or as 2 after the cut. Episode 3 says more about this counter.
计数器回来是 3，剪断后是 2。这个计数器第 3 集还会细讲。
Then it asks each slave for register 0x0110, DL Status: the state of its ports.
然后逐个读从站的寄存器 0x0110，DL 状态，也就是各个口的状态。
Two bits per port. Pattern 10 means: open, and communication established with the neighbour.
每个口两位。10 这个组合的意思是：打开了，而且和邻居建立了通信。
SOEM tests each port in turn, and remembers the open ones.
SOEM 挨个检查每个口，把打开的口记下来。
Intact line: slave 1 and J1 show both ports open, J2 only port 0.
完整的总线：从站 1 和 J1 两个口都开，J2 只开口 0。
After the cut, J1 shows only port 0. The open ports tell SOEM where the line ends.
剪断后，J1 也只剩口 0 开着。哪些口开着，就告诉了 SOEM 总线在哪里结束。

title: More than two ports
lines: Some slaves have 3 or 4 ports, so the cable can branch.
有些从站有 3 个或 4 个口，网线就能分叉。
Same rule: each port hands the frame to the next. It walks every branch in turn, then comes home: a tree is still one ring.
还是同一条规则：每个口把帧交给下一个口。帧把每条支路挨个走完再回家：树形也还是一个环。

title: Recap
lines: One: every cable is two lanes, one pair each way, both at once.
一、每根网线都是两条车道：一对线一个方向，同时工作。
Two: the slave works on the frame on the way out. A port with no cable closes, and the frame turns around.
二、从站在去程上处理帧；没插线的口自动关闭，帧在那里掉头。
Three: so a line of slaves is already a ring, and a cut only makes it shorter.
三、所以一串从站本身就是一个环；剪断只会让环变短。

title: Your turn
lines: A line has 5 slaves. The cable after slave 3 is cut.
一条总线有 5 个从站，从站 3 后面的网线断了。
How many slaves does the master find? Which port closes?
主站能找到几个从站？哪个口会关闭？
pause
3 slaves. Slave 3's port 1 closes, and the frame turns around there.
3 个从站。从站 3 的口 1 关闭，帧在那里掉头。
Next: the frame is back after 1.5 µs. But even the shortest frame takes 5.8 µs to send.
下一集：帧 1.5 微秒就回来了，可最短的帧发出去也要 5.8 微秒。
Its head is home before its tail has left. Episode 3: processing on the fly.
帧头回到了家，帧尾还没出门。第 3 集：边走边处理。
